Laya Rust inference
Source: https://github.com/aovestdipaperino/laya-rust
Revision: 8c50e61b1507638c4c1c7630633f4ce776d127db
Original package version: 0.1.1
Author: Enzo Lombardi and the laya-rust contributors
License: Apache-2.0, reproduced in LICENSE

The ModernBERT encoder was adapted upstream from candle-transformers 0.9.2,
licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT. This copy uses the Apache-2.0 option.
Candle source: https://github.com/huggingface/candle
The upstream adaptation makes attention masks follow the model dtype.

Lince adaptations: library only; Candle 0.11; tokenizers 0.22 without default
features or esaxx_fast/cpp; explicit CPU default; prompt-budget inspection.
Code comments are omitted to follow the host repository's source convention.
The model weights are separately obtained from convaiinnovations/laya and
declare Apache-2.0. They are not included in this source package.

The BERT encoder is adapted from candle-transformers 0.11.0, under its
Apache-2.0 option. Source:
https://github.com/huggingface/candle/blob/0.11.0/candle-transformers/src/models/bert.rs
It uses candle_nn linear/layer_norm directly in place of tracing wrappers.
